useWhen: Validating technical architecture is secure and compliant
Getting threat model and compliance roadmap
Assessing if architecture is ready to build

workflow.description: Accept input from Validation Pack or standalone product description, confirm target market geography, document existing security infrastructure
Produce system architecture with containers, data flows, auth design, tech stack choices
Define minimum security bar, map requirements to components, identify P0 vs P1 requirements
Apply STRIDE analysis to architecture components, identify threats by category, document risk ratings
Evaluate architecture against threats, trace auth flows, assess data handling security
Full data lifecycle inventory, map PII exposure, define retention policies
Triage applicable regulations, assess compliance status, draft privacy policy sections
Phase timeline for quick wins vs long-term, estimate certification costs, consolidate findings
Compile pack with architecture summary, security posture, data protection, compliance, risk register, and verdict

examples.input: Is our architecture ready to build? Validate technical readiness
examples.output: Technical readiness pack with verdict (READY/NEEDS WORK/REDESIGN), threat model, compliance roadmap, and risk register
examples.context: Pre-build validation of security and compliance posture

examples.input: Run full security assessment on our architecture
examples.output: Complete technical readiness assessment with security findings, data protection status, and regulatory compliance roadmap
examples.context: Comprehensive security review before product launch
